baseline.basis: New session: task_started is first event and no token_count events precede this task. Zero is the cumulative session origin, not an observed token_count snapshot.

scope: All inspection, planning, implementation, validation, reporting, and original final response in this turn; exclude subsequent follow-up turns.

assumptions: Existing runnable sample or local fixture available
Approximately 10-20 model calls including supplied context, tool results, validation, and reporting

measurement_label: Complete recorded usage for the original Task A turn.
accounting_rules: Subtract ending cumulative counters minus starting counters; never sum snapshots.
Cached input tokens are included in input tokens.
Reasoning output tokens are included in output tokens.
Total tokens = input tokens + output tokens.
No dollar cost or credits were measured.
